task: The temporary_affairs folder holds a large backlog of ad hoc requests accumulated over time with no triage. Work out what each is asking for, whether it was ever resolved, and who it belongs to. Produce a triage file recording request, owner, status and age, sorted by how long each has been outstanding. Put the items with no identifiable owner into a separate list, since an unowned request is not merely old, it is nobody's to close and will sit there until somebody is assigned. Where a request duplicates another, say so rather than listing both, and where you cannot tell whether something was resolved, mark it as such rather than guessing.
